name: Stiffleaf penstemon
desc: Stiffleaf penstemon (Penstemon aridus): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 7 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Penstemon aridus, commonly called the stiffleaf penstemon, is a species from the northwestern United States in Idaho, Montana, and Wyoming. It is a member of the veronica family.
